Choice Privileges World Elite Mastercard Credit Card Terms and Conditions

Choice Privileges® Mastercard® Credit Card Terms and Conditions

_Issued and administered by Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., pursuant to a license from Mastercard International._

IMPORTANT DISCLOSURES

Interest Rates and Interest Charges

| Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for Purchases | 19.99%, 24.74%, or 28.74%, based on your creditworthiness. This APR will vary with the market based on the U.S. Prime Rate. |

| Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for Balance Transfers | 19.99%, 24.74%, or 28.74%, based on your creditworthiness. Balance Transfers are subject to eligibility. This APR will vary with the market based on the U.S. Prime Rate. |

| APR for Cash Advances | 29.74% This APR will vary with the market based on the U.S. Prime Rate. |

| How to Avoid Paying Interest on Purchases | Your due date is at least 25 days after the close of each billing period. We will not charge you any interest on purchases if you pay your entire adjusted balance by the due date each month. |

| Minimum Interest Charge | If you are charged interest, the charge will be no less than $1.00. |

| For Credit Card Tips from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau | To learn more about factors to consider when applying for or using a credit card, visit the website of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau at https://www.consumerfinance.gov/learnmore. |

Fees

| Annual Fee | None |

| Transaction Fees | |

| - Balance Transfers | Up to 5% for each balance transfer, with a minimum of $5. |

| - Cash Advances | Either $10 or 5% of the amount of each advance, whichever is greater. |

| - Foreign Currency Conversion/Foreign Transaction | None |

| Penalty Fees | |

| - Late Payment | Up to $40 |

How we will calculate your balance

We use a method called "average daily balance (including new purchases)".

We will begin charging interest on cash advances and balance transfers on the transaction date.

Important Information About Balance Transfer(s)

  • Balance transfers are contingent on approval of your account.
  • You cannot transfer a balance from any account issued by Wells Fargo or any of its affiliates.
  • The total amount of your balance transfer request(s), including fees, cannot exceed your available credit. If your request(s) exceed your available credit, we may send less than the amount requested, or no amount, to your creditor.
  • It will take about two weeks to complete the processing of your balance transfer request(s). If you decide to cancel a balance transfer request, please contact us at 1-800-642-4720 immediately and prior to confirming your card.
  • Balance transfers do not earn rewards.
